en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street beside an old stone wall covered with ivy. Several men in dark academic-style cloaks are gathered; some hold long staffs or batons pointed toward a central man, suggesting a ritual or initiation. Another man in a coat stands to the right observing. The scene is outdoors, likely in an old university quarter. The top right bears the city name, and a caption in the lower right describes the scene.
